description: Sign-in, MFA, privileged access, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every CDE administrator path and every division application federates to SYS-G1; no sign-in means no administration, settlement operations, or support
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; authorization keeps running without workforce sign-in
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; Merchant Consulting's legacy identity provider (SYS-M1) federates to it

description: Two group data centers, wide-area network, and the dedicated card network links
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Authorization (BP-PP01) and the token vault run active-active in both data centers; card network links are the only path to issuers
manual_workaround: Fail over to the surviving data center; second network link per card network
dependent_systems: SYS-G3 data centers; card network links
dependent_third_parties: Telecommunications carriers; card networks (through the sponsor banks)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Payment Processing CDE (SYS-P1 to SYS-P3); private links to providers A and B

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Hub network, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: SYS-P4 to SYS-P6 run in provider A; the Software division's gateway and commerce SaaS run in provider B
manual_workaround: Provider-native failover inside each provider; division accounts keep running if the hub is degraded but reachable
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: E-commerce API, merchant portal, dispute platform, gateway, commerce SaaS, data platform

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, DNS and egress monitoring, and incident handling
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: PCI DSS requires security events reviewed without gaps; notice clocks (card brands, 12 CFR 53.4, 16 CFR 314.4(j), Form 8-K Item 1.05) keep running during an outage
manual_workaround: Retainer firm's tooling; EDR console access from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division depends on the SOC for detection and the facts behind every notice

description: Receive authorization requests from terminals, the e-commerce API, and the gateway; route to card networks; return responses
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Real time: about 80 million authorizations a day (about $35.6 million division revenue per day); merchants switch to backup processors within hours; card network availability rules
manual_workaround: None for card-not-present; stand-in limits at the card networks for some card-present traffic
dependent_people_or_facilities: Switch operations; on-call engineers; both data centers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 data centers and network links; SYS-G1 for administrators; receives about 70% of the gateway's traffic (SYS-S2)

description: Tokenize and detokenize PAN; PIN translation; key management in the payment HSM clusters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the vault and HSMs no PAN can be tokenized, decrypted, or routed; dual control is needed for any key ceremony
manual_workaround: None; HSM clusters in each data center back each other up
dependent_people_or_facilities: Key custodians (dual control); both data centers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 data centers; SYS-S3 device key loading depends on it

business_process: E-commerce payment API and hosted payment fields
description: Card-not-present API and the hosted fields embedded by merchants and by Software division storefronts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 45% of volume is card-not-present; storefronts on SYS-S1 embed these fields
manual_workaround: Merchants with a backup processor fail over; none otherwise
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; content delivery service
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 provider A landing zone; Software division storefronts (BP-SW03) depend on it

description: Gateway API, SDKs, and ISV portal; routes to the processor and six unaffiliated processors
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 6.2 billion transactions a year; 1,900 ISVs and their merchants stop taking card-not-present payments; about 70% of traffic feeds BP-PP01
manual_workaround: None for e-commerce; card-present devices can route directly to the processor for some merchants
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; six unaffiliated processors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 provider B landing zone; SYS-G1; feeds the processor's authorization (BP-PP01)

description: Point-of-sale software for about 410,000 merchants (orders, payments, receipts)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants cannot ring up sales normally; payments route through the gateway
manual_workaround: Devices run in offline mode for cash and store-and-forward card payments within merchant-set limits
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-S2 gateway; processor authorization for about 70% of transactions

description: About 180,000 hosted online stores using the gateway's hosted fields
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchants lose online sales; storefront pages host the payment fields that card data passes through
manual_workaround: Merchants post a temporary closed notice; no alternate checkout
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider B; content delivery service
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-P4 hosted fields for processor merchants; app marketplace third parties

description: Build daily clearing files from approved transactions; reconcile with card network settlement reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Daily network settlement cycle; covered service to the four sponsor banks under 12 U.S.C. 1867(c)
manual_workaround: Hold and reprocess the next cycle; manual reconciliation by settlement staff
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 data centers; dispute adjustments from SYS-P6 (BP-PP07)

description: Net amounts per merchant; daily ACH funding files to each sponsor bank by its cutoff (about $3.8 billion a day)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A missed cutoff delays money for merchants of that bank; a disruption of 4 or more hours to this covered service triggers the bank service provider notice (12 CFR 53.4; 225.303; 304.24)
manual_workaround: Send the prior day's validated adjustments; agree a late file window with the sponsor bank
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Chargeback adjustments from SYS-P6 and dispute analysts in Merchant Consulting (BP-MC01)

description: Score every authorization with the fraud-detection model
process_owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Fallback velocity and amount rules keep authorizations running at higher fraud risk
manual_workaround: Fallback rules in the switch; analysts tighten merchant limits
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Training data from SYS-G4; model monitoring by model risk management

description: Merchants view transactions and deposits, key in card-not-present sales, issue refunds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchant complaints; refunds and keyed sales stop; about 2.1 million users
manual_workaround: Support processes refunds on request; merchants use terminals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 for staff access; SYS-G3 provider A

business_process: Sponsor bank and card network notices
description: Notices and reporting to the four sponsor banks and the card networks, including incident notices
process_owner: Head of bank and network relationships
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Card brand 3-day compromise clocks; 24-hour contract notice to sponsor banks; bank service provider notices as soon as possible after the 4-hour determination
manual_workaround: Phone and the out-of-band contact list in the incident binder
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Facts from the group SOC (BP-G02); covers incidents that start in any division

business_process: ISV and merchant support and incident notices
description: Support desks and contractual notices to ISVs and merchants
process_owner: Software division client trust and assurance director
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: ISV agreement 24-hour notice for credential incidents; 48-hour notice for 140 enterprise merchants
manual_workaround: Email and phone from the out-of-band contact list
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group SOC facts drive every notice

description: Answer merchant calls and tickets about authorization, funding, and disputes
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Merchant complaints; regulators and sponsor banks watch complaint volumes
manual_workaround: Call scripts; callbacks
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G5; SYS-G1

description: Chargeback responses and representment for about 2,100 merchants (about 2.9 million chargebacks a year)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Card network response windows are counted in days, so a 3-day outage risks lost representment rights; revenue about $6.4 million per business day for the division
manual_workaround: Merchants respond directly in SYS-P6 or other processors' portals; extend staffing after recovery
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on SYS-P6 (Payment Processing) and on federation of SYS-M1 to SYS-G1; feeds chargeback adjustments into funding (BP-PP04)

description: Receive dispute notices from the networks, post adjustments, manage representment
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Network response deadlines in days; adjustments feed the daily funding file
manual_workaround: Queue disputes; post adjustments in the next cycle
dependent_people_or_facilities: Chargeback operations; Merchant Consulting dispute analysts
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Merchant Consulting staff do much of the work (BP-MC01)

description: Email, files, and chat for the workforce
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Staff coordination and external notices; attackers may read email during an incident (out-of-band channels exist)
manual_workaround: Out-of-band bridge and phones; Merchant Consulting still uses SYS-M1
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division; incident notices are sent from it

description: Build, test, and deploy releases for SYS-S1 to SYS-S3
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Security fixes cannot ship
manual_workaround: Freeze releases; hotfix path through break-glass with two approvals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 for engineer access

description: Engagement files, client deliverables, and client email on SYS-M1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client deliverable dates; 72-hour client incident notice in engagement letters
manual_workaround: Work from group email for urgent client contact
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Migration to SYS-G1 and SYS-G5 planned 2027-03-31

description: Configuration, software updates, and key loading for about 640,000 devices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Devices keep working without the service; new device activations and updates stop
manual_workaround: Defer activations; ship pre-configured devices
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Key loading uses the processor's payment HSMs (BP-PP02)

business_process: Group data platform analytics and model training
description: Tokenized analytics, regulatory and card network reporting, fraud model training
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Model retraining and monthly network reports can wait; must hold tokens only
manual_workaround: Defer batch jobs; division systems keep operating
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Fraud model training (BP-PP06); Software division product analytics

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; outside filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and every division

description: Applications, identity and risk checks, approval of new merchants
process_owner: Head of merchant risk and fraud
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New merchant revenue can wait a few days
manual_workaround: Queue applications
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Merchant Consulting refers new merchants

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; termination events drive access removal
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Termination events feed SYS-G1; Merchant Consulting terminations still feed SYS-M1 by hand

description: Checkout and terminal integration projects in clients' environments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Project dates can move
manual_workaround: Reschedule client work
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: ISV support console access (Software division)

description: Generative answers about a merchant's own sales data for about 58,000 merchants
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Optional feature; merchants can use standard reports
manual_workaround: Turn the feature off
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

description: Payments strategy, cost advisory, and PCI DSS readiness work for clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Advisory work can be rescheduled
manual_workaround: Reschedule
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None
